name: Steak with Black Pepper-Dijon Sauce, Roasted Asparagus & Carrots

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the asparagus. Snap or cut off woody ends, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Divide between two baking sheet pans.
Wash, dry, peel, and slice carrots into thin rounds. Divide between baking sheets.
Peel and mince garlic and onion; sprinkle both over the veggies. Drizzle with oil, season with salt, and toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 medium red onion
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and roast veggies, tossing once, until fork-tender, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a large plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with foil.

Return skillet to medium-high heat; add cream, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer. Cook until heated through and slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml heavy cream
⅓ cup Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, thinly slice steak into strips.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates. Top steak with sauce and enjoy!
